The [Triangle Area Calculator](/triangle-area-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Triangle area and perimeter from three side lengths. Enter your side a, side b and side c and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Triangle area and perimeter from three side lengths. This free online triangle area calculator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Triangle Area Calculator

Start by entering your side a, then entering your side b and finally entering your side c. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your side a.
2. Enter your side b.
3. Enter your side c.
4. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
5. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

s = (a+b+c)/2; area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)).

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Triangle Area Calculator](/triangle-area-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.
